# `<dev/protocols/mmcdrv.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Block-device protocol shared by every SD/MMC driver ("/dev/mmc0").

One client at a time. Every request gets exactly one reply, sent once the transfer has finished. Requests and replies travel in the message buffer; block data goes through the buffer page from SD_CMD_GET_BUF.

```c
#include <dev/protocols/mmcdrv.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="sd_cmd_get_buf"></a>`SD_CMD_GET_BUF` | `1` | Get the transfer buffer. [SdRequest](#sdrequest) {cmd}; replies [SdReply](#sdreply) and grants the driver-owned buffer page (PERM_MAP \| PERM_WRITE \| PERM_TXFR). Asking again grants the same buffer. |
| <a id="sd_cmd_read"></a>`SD_CMD_READ` | `2` | Read blocks. [SdRequest](#sdrequest) {cmd, lba, count}; the data lands at buffer offset 0. |
| <a id="sd_cmd_write"></a>`SD_CMD_WRITE` | `3` | Write blocks. [SdRequest](#sdrequest) {cmd, lba, count}; the data is taken from buffer offset 0. |
| <a id="sd_err_io"></a>`SD_ERR_IO` | `ERR_IO` | A block transfer failed: CRC error, timeout, or FIFO overrun or underrun. |
| <a id="sd_block_size"></a>`SD_BLOCK_SIZE` | `512u` | Bytes per block. |
| <a id="sd_buf_size"></a>`SD_BUF_SIZE` | `4096u` | Size of the transfer buffer: one page, so at most 8 blocks per request. |

## Structures

### `SdRequest` { #sdrequest }

A request, in the message buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | An SD_CMD_* value. |
| `lba` | `uint32_t` | First block. |
| `count` | `uint32_t` | Number of blocks. |

### `SdReply` { #sdreply }

A reply, in the message buffer; READ and WRITE fill in only `status`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](../../../errors.md#err) | ZUZU_OK, or an error code. |
| `buf_size` | `uint32_t` | GET_BUF: size of the transfer buffer. |
| `block_size` | `uint32_t` | GET_BUF: bytes per block. |
| `block_count` | `uint32_t` | GET_BUF: blocks on the card, or 0 if unknown. |
